sources.name: pose-down
sources.prompt:
Precise production sprite-layer repair. The input contains FOUR poses of the same black-haired cat-eared girl in a 2x2 grid with generous transparent padding. Repair these four isolated character BODY layers. REMOVE EVERY SWORD, SWORD HANDLE, CROSSGUARD, MINT SLASH ARC and detached fragment from neighboring frames. Reconstruct complete feet/shoes and hair where the input crops cut them. Keep the exact same girl, face, black cat ears, grey eyes, long black hair, black long dress, cross necklace, shoes, art style and distinct animation poses. Her anatomical RIGHT hand must be a visibly CLOSED EMPTY FIST, with a complete wrist and forearm connected to the right shoulder; we will attach a separate sword to this exact fist in code. Left hand empty and relaxed/open. No sword-shaped object or glowing trail anywhere. One complete girl per quadrant: top-left windup, top-right slash, bottom-left follow-through, bottom-right recovery. Each girl has BOTH feet clearly present and correctly oriented. Keep each character centered inside its own equal quadrant at the same scale as input (about half a quadrant's height), preserve large transparent margins so NO hair, feet or limb crosses quadrant boundaries. True transparent alpha, no text, grid, scenery, floor shadows or extra limbs.
All four girls face FORWARD toward the viewer. Their RIGHT fists are on SCREEN LEFT, and the screen-right left hands stay empty. Keep the right fist clearly visible even during the cross-body poses, without switching arms.

sources.name: foot-3
sources.prompt: Precise local correction to this single transparent sprite. The girl faces RIGHT. Correct ONLY the feet/shoes: the foreground boot's toe is wrongly pointing LEFT. Redraw the footwear and lower ankle so the toe points RIGHT, following her face and body. Both shoes must face RIGHT, even the lifted/recoiling foot. Preserve the exact existing leg pose, ankle attachment, knee, skirt hem, body, hair, face, sword, right-hand grip, size, pixel placement and transparency. Keep the foreground shoe in the same location, change its orientation rather than mirroring the whole character or swapping legs. This is the opposite walking step; maintain the raised rear foot. One intact boot per foot, no extra feet. No changes above the lower skirt/ankle region. Output the same square framing with true transparent background.

Remove this cross completely and restore the plain black fabric underneath. All four sprites are BACK VIEWS; no necklace or silver cross should be visible on any back view. assembly: AI edits produce body/foot layers only. scripts/prepare-wand2-sprites.mjs packs isolated poses, adds a shared sword at reviewed right-fist anchors, restores the grip over the handle, and adds bounded slash effects. Only the two configured foot rectangles replace pixels in character-original.webp.
